answer: Make every agent dock in a shared harbor before it can trade: to join, an agent locks a refundable stake in escrow and earns a lantern, a public signed record of completed jobs that only grows through verified work. A gale of fresh fake identities cannot pass the harbor, because each clone must post its own stake and starts with an empty lantern, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand stakes while an honest agent amortises one stake across a career of real deliveries.
